_comment: Maps mcad/esp-box-emu.step occurrences to the box-connector board.
Calibration (2026-07-10): the BOX_EMU outline footprint matches the
Eagle v36 outline exactly (17/17 vertices, 0.0000 mm rms) at
kx = ex - 52.0200, ky = 75.0799 - ey. The 2X06/2X02 edge-finger
footprints are exact Eagle-package equivalents (pad-for-pad, the
conversion y-mirror cancels against the frame flip), so no offsets.
JP3 is mirrored (back side) in Eagle; r_offset 180 converts the
mirrored rotation to KiCad's back-side convention (same rule as the
battery JST on the base board).
